summary_md: **Sumit ([@_reachsumit](https://x.com/_reachsumit/status/2115476956242473072))** shares **AutoRSE**, a benchmark of LLM agents acting as recommendation engineers on six recommender tasks. The key finding he highlights: agents' gains come mostly from hyperparameter tuning and ensembling rather than inventing new algorithms. Paper and code are linked.

referenced_urls.title: AutoRSE: Evaluating LLM Agents as Recommendation Engineers for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
GitHub - Ray-Tiann/AutoRSE: AutoRSE: A benchmark and evaluation framework for LLM agents in autonomous recommender system research and optimization.

relevance: A sober measurement of how 'creative' autonomous research agents really are in an applied domain.
